findings.claim: Step 1 and the four stop-hook texts point to a new review result of the same head as the only way the check runs again. They also say correctly that `review check` refuses the head while the held result is stored. Clearance requires every stored result of the head to be clear, so a clear new result does not clear the head. None of the texts says what does end the refusal: a new head, or the owner removing or deciding about the held result. The F1 claim of 19d59ac19897-3 named 'a new -<n> or the owner'. The fix keeps only the first, so an agent can still run a new review of the same head expecting it to make the head deliverable, and then hit the same refusal. No stated fact is false, so this stays a SUGGESTION.

evidence: Read the whole diff t4ec.diff (211 lines, 10 paths), including the L107 entry and the T4e-c segment of the T4 line.

Closure of 19d59ac19897-3 F1: the old instruction 'A stored `not-run` keeps it waiting: run the check again' is gone. Step 1 now says `review verify` refuses a second verdict and the check runs again only in a new review result of the same head. verify.go:106-111 confirms this: Create on an existing verdict returns ErrExists, which becomes ErrAlreadyVerified, and nothing is stored. A second `review record` on the same head is not refused (app has no such error), and its verify is not ErrCorrectionSpent, because round.go:14 IsCorrection requires another head. F1 is closed.

Closure of the 19d59ac19897-2.polisher SUGGESTION: the README entry and section, the CHANGELOG and usage.sh replace 'for it' with 'for each check it needs'. This matches decide.go:102-112 (for an unknown disposition the base check must also be reproduced or not-reproduced, unless head is not-reproduced) and decide.go:114-120. The docs test now fails on the stale phrase 'not-reproduced for it'. The polisher SUGGESTION is closed.

Truth of 'holds it for good': classify.go:96 skips any result where unverifiedOf is non-empty, and a stored not-run on a needed check stays fateUnchecked (decide.go:111, :120) with no second verdict possible (verify.go:111). It is true while the files stay stored.

Truth of 'review check refuses the head while the held result is stored': Clearance (check.go:128-145) iterates every result of the head and returns ErrNotClear 'findings not checked' for a non-clear, non-blocking one, unless another result blocks (ErrBlocked, check.go:137). This is consistent with the texts.
